notes: W. McMicken Av runs SSW from Warner; at y 3563 its straight continuation is the Iron Bridge road (60', over the Miami Canal towards Colerain, labelled IRON BRIDGE) and McMicken itself turns SSE then SE, with a retaining-wall wedge (tip at x 2390, y 4400) between the two. The Iron Bridge does not open straight onto Colerain (its west parapet carries on SE as a wall forming Colerain's NE edge), so no Colerain/Iron Bridge junction is recorded. Warner is 40' west of the '?' street at x 4925 and 50' east of it; the hatched strip along its north side is inside the 40' (the north line at y 366-390 is the street line). That '?' street (about 19') enters from the top edge and Ts into Warner; it is not named here or on the key map (Fairview Av on the key map meets Warner further east, beyond this sheet). The second '?' is a 20' street from McMicken (y 4105) east to the right edge, unnamed here and on the key map; Emming (printed EMMING (NOT OPEN), 40') leaves it at a shallow angle right at the north end of Kress Alley, so the Emming and Kress Alley T's on it are only 130 px apart. Kress Alley is printed ALLEY on its upper part and KRESS on its lower part (10' tapering to 8' at McMicken; the 40' printed next to KRESS is Klotter's width). Conroy St west of Freeman is only 10'. Freeman Av (45') runs from Emming south to McMicken; Conroy, Klotter and Emming are slightly offset across Freeman, points placed at the centre of each crossing. A FOOT BRIDGE over the canal behind the SW-side McMicken lots and the Fairview Heights inclined plane are not recorded. Colerain Av runs down the left side with no intersections on this sheet. The vertical dashed lines lettered A and B are boundary lines, not streets.
